title: How is Hitler linked to Walter White?
description: Five real photos connect Adolf Hitler to Walter White, through a former king, the Queen, Barack Obama and Bryan Cranston.
hook: How is Hitler connected to Walter White?
fun_fact: Barack Obama lunched with the Queen at Windsor Castle on 22 April 2016 and sat down with Bryan Cranston at the White House exactly a week later, weeks before Cranston appeared on HBO as President Lyndon B. Johnson in All the Way.
research_note: Two fresh ways out of Hitler were tried first: the Eiger climber Heinrich Harrer, later the Dalai Lama's tutor, has no reusable copy of his 1938 photo with Hitler, and Anthony Eden, who met Hitler in 1935, has no photo with the Queen, so the chain leaves Hitler through Edward VIII and reaches Cranston through the Obama White House's photos.

image.file: File:Duc et duchesse de Windsor avec Hitler (1937).jpg

links.line: In 1937, Hitler hosted Britain's former king, Edward VIII, at his mountain home.
In the 1930s, Edward posed with his niece, the future Queen Elizabeth.

links.line: In 2016, the Queen hosted Barack Obama for lunch at Windsor Castle.

links.line: A week later, Obama sat down at the White House with Bryan Cranston.

links.line: And in 2008, Bryan Cranston became Walter White in Breaking Bad.
